stories.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual pelo Avante em MS; veja quem são e os números

en.title: Candidates for state deputy by Avante in MS; see who they are and the numbers
en.summary: Mato Grosso do Sul has 241 candidates competing for 24 seats in the state legislature in the 2026 elections, according to electoral authority data. The first round of voting is scheduled for October 4, 2026.

stories.title: Escola municipal da Grande BH suspende aulas após surto de sarna

en.title: Municipal school in Greater BH suspends classes after scabies outbreak
en.summary: A municipal school in Lagoa Santa, near Belo Horizonte, closed after confirming 20 cases of scabies among students and staff. The outbreak was first reported on September 18 when a student showed symptoms.

stories.title: TSE aprova envio de tropas federais para sete municípios de Alagoas nas Eleições 2026

en.title: TSE approves deployment of federal troops to seven municipalities in Alagoas for 2026 elections
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Electoral Court unanimously approved sending federal forces to seven municipalities in Alagoas during the 2026 elections. The decision aims to ensure security and normality of the electoral process.

stories.title: Veja os números dos candidatos ao Senado em SP nas eleições 2026

en.title: See the numbers of Senate candidates in SP in the 2026 elections
en.summary: Fourteen candidates are competing for two Senate seats representing São Paulo in the 2026 elections. Voters will cast their ballots on October 4 using three-digit numbers.

stories.title: Filme de 'Game of Thrones' sobre Aegon Targaryen ganha data de estreia para 2029

en.title: Game of Thrones Film About Aegon Targaryen Gets 2029 Release Date
en.summary: Warner Bros announced that Game of Thrones will arrive in cinemas for the first time with a film titled Game of Thrones: Aegon's Conquest, set to release on June 1, 2029.

stories.title: Novo Caps em Salvador atende 24 horas crianças e adolescentes em crise de saúde mental; saiba como ter acesso ao serviço

en.title: New Caps in Salvador Operates 24 Hours Attending Children and Adolescents in Mental Health Crisis; Learn How to Access the Service
en.summary: Salvador opened a new 24-hour mental health center for children and adolescents called Caps Infantojuvenil Mané Dendê, offering services on weekends and holidays for those experiencing mental health crises or serious persistent disorders.

stories.title: ‘Boutique de saúde’: novo serviço de saúde ajuda na logística do cuidado de idosos

en.title: 'Health Boutique': New Health Service Helps with Logistics of Elderly Care
en.summary: A new health service described as a health boutique has been launched to assist with the logistical aspects of providing care for elderly individuals.

stories.title: A Conquista de Aegon vai trazer Game of Thrones aos cinemas em 2029

en.title: Aegon's Conquest Will Bring Game of Thrones to Cinemas in 2029
en.summary: A Game of Thrones film is coming to cinemas in 2029, marking the franchise's first theatrical release.

stories.title: Games nas eleições 2026: Veja propostas dos candidatos à presidência para o setor de jogos

en.title: Gaming in 2026 elections: See presidential candidates' proposals for the gaming sector
en.summary: Presidential candidates for the 2026 election have presented various proposals regarding the gaming sector in Brazil.

stories.title: Dino manda PF investigar disseminação de ataques a imagens católicas

en.title: Dino orders Federal Police to investigate spread of attacks on Catholic religious images
en.summary: A Supreme Court minister ordered federal police to investigate reports of attacks on Catholic religious images across the country following his decision to restore online posts critical of efforts to remove a Catholic saint's patronage status.

stories.title: Dino pede inquérito sobre 'ataques a imagens religiosas' após Nossa Senhora virar pauta eleitoral

en.title: Dino requests investigation into 'attacks on religious images' after Our Lady becomes election topic
en.summary: A Supreme Court minister ordered the federal police to open an investigation into what he described as a wave of recent attacks against religious images.

stories.title: Dino manda investigar ataques a imagens religiosas em meio a fake news de Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Dino orders investigation of attacks on religious images amid fake news about Our Lady of Aparecida
en.summary: A Supreme Court minister ordered an investigation into attacks on religious images occurring amid misinformation about a Brazilian Catholic saint's patronage status.

stories.title: Ford está preocupada com escassez de mão de obra e o que isso significa para a indústria

en.title: Ford is concerned about labor shortage and what it means for the industry
en.summary: Ford Motor is addressing a major bottleneck for U.S. manufacturing revival by tackling industrial labor scarcity. The automaker is convening business leaders in Detroit to discuss the workforce shortage affecting the sector.

stories.title: Grupos europeus se unem para desafiar domínio das gigantes americanas Visa e Mastercard

en.title: European groups unite to challenge dominance of American giants Visa and Mastercard
en.summary: European payment groups including Spain's Bizum, Italy's Bancomat, and Brussels-based Wero announced a cross-border payments network to reduce European dependence on Visa and Mastercard. The new joint venture, European Network for Payments, will be headquartered in Madrid.

stories.title: Celso Neto encerra temporada da IMSA em Road Atlanta

en.title: Celso Neto closes IMSA season at Road Atlanta
en.summary: Brazilian driver Celso Neto competes in the final race of the 2026 IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge season at Road Atlanta in Georgia. Neto and British co-driver Jenson Brickley drive for Stallion Motorsports in their first competitive season.

stories.title: Coinbase defende stablecoins dentro do marco cripto e alerta para risco de insegurança regulatória

en.title: Coinbase defends stablecoins within crypto framework and warns of regulatory uncertainty risk
en.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase urges Brazil's incoming government and Congress to regulate stablecoins within the existing crypto legal framework rather than treating them as electronic or foreign currency. The company highlights regulatory clarity as essential for Brazil's financial future.

stories.title: Manifestantes acampam na Espanha e exigem aprovação de medidas para habitação

en.title: Protesters camp in Spain and demand approval of housing measures
en.summary: Thousands of demonstrators camped in Madrid's main square and other Spanish cities are calling for Parliament to quickly pass new measures to protect tenants and address the country's housing crisis, prompted by the eviction of an elderly woman.
